<figure id="fig-tool-roundtrip" class="course-figure" aria-labelledby="fig-tool-roundtrip-caption">
<svg viewBox="0 0 720 410" role="img" aria-label="A tool-call round trip in three lanes: the model generates a structured tool request; the surrounding software checks it and runs the tool; the tool's result is placed into the next context; the model then generates the answer" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>One tool call, from request to answer</title>
  <desc>Three vertical lanes labeled model, surrounding software, and tool and result. Six numbered boxes run from top to bottom, alternating lanes: 1, the user request is placed in the context (software lane); 2, the model generates a structured tool request (model lane); 3, permission check, then the software runs the tool (software lane); 4, the tool returns a result, evidence or an error (tool lane); 5, the result is placed into the next context (software lane); 6, the model generates the answer (model lane). Thin lines connect each box to the next.</desc>
  <g fill="#1c1c1c">
    <g font-size="14" font-weight="600">
      <text x="150" y="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b3fa0">model</text>

      <text x="597" y="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f5b6e">tool and result</text>
    </g>

    <rect x="45" y="104" width="210" height="54" rx="8" fill="#ece7f7" stroke="#5b3fa0" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="150" y="126" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13">2. the model generates a</text>

</svg>
<figcaption id="fig-tool-roundtrip-caption">One tool call from request to answer. Purple boxes are generated output from the model; gray boxes are actions taken by the surrounding software and the tool; green boxes are context supplied to a model call. The model never runs anything itself: it generates the request in step 2 and the answer in step 6, and everything between is performed outside the model and returned as evidence.</figcaption>
</figure>
